basicOptions.displayName: 任务领取 · 决策次数或任务状态

documentLinks.title: 有领取决策指标时显示窗口新增次数。版本未上报该指标时，按窗口内可见任务的最新快照去重，显示有无启动记录。快照无法统计空轮询或拒绝次数。

queryLines: * | WITH deployment_log AS (SELECT * FROM log WHERE instance = coalesce(nullif(url_decode('${{multica_deployment|}}'),''), (SELECT instance FROM log
GROUP BY instance ORDER BY max(observed_at_ms) DESC, instance LIMIT 1))), samples AS (

SELECT instance, concat(concat(coalesce(nullif(pod_uid,''),nullif(pod_name,''),nullif(pod_ip,''),'legacy'),'|',source_name),'|',entity_id) AS entity_id, evidence_kind, metric_name, metric_labels, route, method, http_status,
FROM deployment_log WHERE record_type = 'prometheus_sample' AND metric_name IN ('multica_agent_task_claim_decision_total')

GROUP BY instance, concat(concat(coalesce(nullif(pod_uid,''),nullif(pod_name,''),nullif(pod_ip,''),'legacy'),'|',source_name),'|',entity_id), evidence_kind, metric_name, metric_labels, route, method, http_status, observed_at_ms
PARTITION BY instance, entity_id ORDER BY observed_at_ms
SELECT *, CASE WHEN value >= previous_value THEN value - previous_value ELSE value END AS delta
FROM previous WHERE previous_value IS NOT NULL
FROM deltas GROUP BY metric_labels HAVING sum(delta)>0
WHEN raw_reason='no_visible_candidates' THEN '这轮没活可领'
WHEN raw_reason='agent_concurrency_cap' THEN '智能体手头任务已满'
WHEN raw_outcome='claimed' AND raw_reason='claimed' THEN '领到了任务'
WHEN raw_outcome='no_capacity' THEN concat('暂时接不了新任务（',raw_reason,'）')
' · ',CASE raw_path WHEN 'batch' THEN '批量' WHEN 'runtime' THEN '单个运行时' WHEN 'agent' THEN '智能体' ELSE raw_path END) AS "领任务的结果",
decisions AS "次数",raw_path AS "原始领取路径",raw_outcome AS "原始结果",raw_reason AS "原始原因",metric_labels AS "原始标签"
WHERE record_type='task_snapshot' AND nullif(task_id,'') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY workspace_id,task_id)
SELECT "领任务的结果","次数" FROM decisions_chart
UNION ALL SELECT IF(nullif(started,'') IS NULL,'尚无启动记录 · 任务数','已开始执行 · 任务数'),count(*) FROM tasks
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM samples) GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL SELECT '窗口内无新增领取决策',0 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deltas) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM decoded)

basicOptions.displayName: 任务各阶段平均耗时 · 进程累计

documentLinks.title: 取各 backend 最近一次有效采样，按累计耗时除以累计任务数计算。重启后重新累计。

queryLines: * | WITH deployment_log AS (SELECT * FROM log WHERE instance = coalesce(nullif(url_decode('${{multica_deployment|}}'),''), (SELECT instance FROM log

GROUP BY instance ORDER BY max(observed_at_ms) DESC, instance LIMIT 1)) AND (( record_type='prometheus_sample' OR record_type='collection_status' ) AND ( record_type='collection_status' OR metric_name='multica_build_info' OR metric_name='multica_http_in_flight_requests' OR metric_name='multica_agent_task_queue_wait_seconds_sum' OR metric_name='multica_agent_task_queue_wait_seconds_count' OR metric_name='multica_agent_task_claimable_wait_seconds_sum' OR metric_name='multica_agent_task_claimable_wait_seconds_count' OR metric_name='multica_agent_task_run_seconds_sum' OR metric_name='multica_agent_task_run_seconds_count' OR metric_name='multica_agent_task_total_seconds_sum' OR metric_name='multica_agent_task_total_seconds_count' ))), server_scrapes AS (

SELECT concat(instance,'|',coalesce(nullif(pod_uid,''),nullif(pod_name,''),nullif(pod_ip,''),'legacy'),'|',source_name) AS scrape_target, concat(concat(instance,'|',coalesce(nullif(pod_uid,''),nullif(pod_name,''),nullif(pod_ip,''),'legacy'),'|',source_name),'|',snapshot_id) AS scrape_batch, max(observed_at_ms) AS sampled_ms
FROM deployment_log WHERE source_name LIKE 'metrics:%' AND snapshot_id IS NOT NULL AND
SELECT scrape_target, sampled_ms-lag(sampled_ms) OVER(PARTITION BY scrape_target ORDER BY sampled_ms) AS spacing_ms
SELECT scrape_target,approx_percentile(CASE WHEN spacing_ms>0 THEN spacing_ms END,0.5) AS period_ms

SELECT concat(instance,'|',coalesce(nullif(pod_uid,''),nullif(pod_name,''),nullif(pod_ip,''),'legacy'),'|',source_name) AS target, concat(concat(instance,'|',coalesce(nullif(pod_uid,''),nullif(pod_name,''),nullif(pod_ip,''),'legacy'),'|',source_name),'|',entity_id) AS entity_id, metric_name, metric_labels, observed_at_ms, max(metric_value) AS value

FROM deployment_log WHERE concat(concat(instance,'|',coalesce(nullif(pod_uid,''),nullif(pod_name,''),nullif(pod_ip,''),'legacy'),'|',source_name),'|',snapshot_id) IN (SELECT scrape_batch FROM server_scrapes)
), latest AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT *,max(observed_at_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY target) AS latest_ms FROM samples) WHERE observed_at_ms=latest_ms)

SELECT CASE regexp_replace(metric_name, '_(sum|count)$', '') WHEN 'multica_agent_task_queue_wait_seconds' THEN '入队至下发' WHEN 'multica_agent_task_claimable_wait_seconds' THEN '可领取至下发' WHEN 'multica_agent_task_run_seconds' THEN '开始至终态' WHEN 'multica_agent_task_total_seconds' THEN '创建至终态' ELSE regexp_replace(metric_name, '_(sum|count)$', '') END AS "耗时阶段",
sum(CASE WHEN metric_name LIKE '%_count' THEN value ELSE 0 END) AS "累计样本数",
round(sum(CASE WHEN metric_name LIKE '%_sum' THEN value ELSE 0 END)/nullif(sum(CASE WHEN metric_name LIKE '%_count' THEN value ELSE 0 END),0),3) AS "平均秒"
FROM latest GROUP BY regexp_replace(metric_name, '_(sum|count)$', '') HAVING sum(CASE WHEN metric_name LIKE '%_count' THEN value ELSE 0 END)>0 ORDER BY "平均秒" DESC

basicOptions.displayName: 单任务执行过程 · 起止时间与阶段耗时

documentLinks.title: 按执行顺序逐行展示。左侧是相对任务起点的起止毫秒，蓝条长度是该阶段耗时。0 ms 的标记显示为时间点。

standardOption.noValue: 这个时间段没有该任务的阶段数据

queryLines: * | WITH deployed AS (SELECT * FROM log WHERE instance = coalesce(nullif(url_decode('${{multica_deployment|}}'),''), (SELECT instance FROM log

GROUP BY instance ORDER BY max(observed_at_ms) DESC, instance LIMIT 1))), deployment_log AS (SELECT * FROM deployed WHERE '${{workspace_id|全部}}'='全部' OR workspace_id='${{workspace_id|全部}}' OR (record_type='collection_status' AND split_part(source_name,':',1)='api' AND split_part(source_name,':',2)='${{workspace_id|全部}}') OR (record_type='server_log' AND nullif(workspace_id,'') IS NULL AND task_id IN (SELECT task_id FROM deployed WHERE record_type='task_snapshot' AND workspace_id='${{workspace_id|全部}}'))), inputs AS (
SELECT task_id, record_type, attempt, status, observed_at_ms, created_at, started_at, dispatched_at, completed_at,
source_time, phase, phase_elapsed_ms, total_elapsed_ms, pod_name, pod_uid, runtime_id, workspace_id, event_id
AND (record_type='task_snapshot' OR (phase IS NOT NULL AND phase_elapsed_ms>=0 AND total_elapsed_ms>=phase_elapsed_ms))
SELECT nullif('${{gantt_task_id|自动}}','自动') AS requested
SELECT task_id FROM inputs GROUP BY task_id
ORDER BY CASE WHEN count_if(record_type='server_log')>0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,max(observed_at_ms) DESC,task_id LIMIT 1
SELECT task_id AS id, attempt, status, observed_at_ms / 1000.0 AS observed,
FROM inputs WHERE task_id=(SELECT id FROM selected) AND record_type='task_snapshot'
ORDER BY observed_at_ms DESC,event_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT task_id AS id, coalesce(nullif(pod_uid,''),nullif(pod_name,''),'未上报') AS host,
coalesce(nullif(runtime_id,''),'未上报') AS runtime, phase, phase_elapsed_ms AS delta_ms,total_elapsed_ms AS elapsed_ms,
coalesce(try(to_unixtime(from_iso8601_timestamp(source_time))), (SELECT started FROM snap WHERE try_cast(attempt AS bigint)=1) + total_elapsed_ms/1000.0) AS marked_s
FROM inputs WHERE task_id=(SELECT id FROM selected) AND record_type='server_log'
PARTITION BY host,runtime ORDER BY marked_s,elapsed_ms,phase ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
FROM raw_phases WHERE marked_s IS NOT NULL
SELECT host,runtime,attempt FROM attempts GROUP BY host,runtime,attempt
ORDER BY max(marked_s) DESC,host,runtime,attempt DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT p.*, first_value(marked_s-elapsed_ms/1000.0) OVER (ORDER BY marked_s,elapsed_ms,phase) AS baseline
FROM attempts p JOIN picked a ON p.host=a.host AND p.runtime=a.runtime AND p.attempt=a.attempt
SELECT id, baseline+(elapsed_ms-delta_ms)/1000.0 AS begin_s,baseline+elapsed_ms/1000.0 AS end_s,delta_ms/1000.0 AS seconds,
CASE phase WHEN 'claimed' THEN '领到任务' WHEN 'prepare_started' THEN '开始准备'
WHEN 'skills_ready' THEN '技能准备完成' WHEN 'environment_ready' THEN '环境就绪'
WHEN 'runtime_started' THEN '运行时启动' WHEN 'first_output_received' THEN '收到首次输出'
WHEN 'first_tool_use' THEN '首次调用工具' WHEN 'turn_completed' THEN '本轮执行结束'
WHEN 'finished' THEN '任务收尾完成' ELSE phase END AS label
SELECT min(baseline) AS begin_s FROM phases
SELECT id, created, dispatched, started, completed, observed, status, begin_s FROM snap CROSS JOIN first_phase
SELECT id,dispatched,begin_s,begin_s-dispatched,'派给运行时后等待领取' FROM summary
FROM summary WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM phases)
SELECT round(begin_s-min(begin_s) OVER (),3) AS "开始偏移",
cast(cast(round((end_s-min(begin_s) OVER ())*1000) AS bigint) AS varchar),' ms  ',
CASE label WHEN '收到首次输出' THEN '等待首次输出' WHEN '技能准备完成' THEN '准备技能' WHEN '环境就绪' THEN '准备环境' WHEN '任务收尾完成' THEN '任务收尾' ELSE label END,
CASE WHEN seconds=0 THEN '（时间点）' ELSE concat('（',cast(cast(round(seconds*1000) AS bigint) AS varchar),' ms）') END) AS "阶段",
id AS "任务 ID",begin_s AS "开始时间",end_s AS "结束时间"
FROM ranges WHERE begin_s IS NOT NULL AND (end_s>begin_s OR (end_s=begin_s AND label NOT IN ('排队等待','派给运行时后等待领取','执行（仅有任务时间）')))
